description: Typing in the formatted composer, generated from web's composer (apps/web/src/chat/rich-text.ts in ProseMirror), one key at a time. `caret` is a visible UTF-16 offset. Each step types `key` at the caret; `placed` steps first place the caret where it is (a tap or click), which drops the style web carries between keys. After each step the composer holds `text` with the caret at visible offset `caret`, and `pending` is the style the next key typed at this caret takes (1 bold, 2 italic), or -1 for the style around the caret. Clients pass the previous step's `pending` as `continuing` when a key types at the caret the previous one left, and -1 after a placed caret. Every client's composer wrapper must produce exactly these steps, with its own caret mapping; see shared/messages/composer.rs.
